AdvancedPlantGenetics.PlantGeneDef.label: perennial
AdvancedPlantGenetics.PlantGeneDef.description: Survives harvest and regrows from about 30% growth instead of being replanted. Saves sowing work and gives quicker follow-up harvests. Recessive: needs two copies to show, so it hides in hybrids.

AdvancedPlantGenetics.PlantGeneDef.label: frost-hardy
AdvancedPlantGenetics.PlantGeneDef.description: Goes dormant in hard frost instead of dying, and loses its leaves only about 20°C later than normal.

AdvancedPlantGenetics.PlantGeneDef.label: polyploid
AdvancedPlantGenetics.PlantGeneDef.description: Doubled chromosome sets. Raises genome capacity by 6, so the plant can carry more improvements without genetic burden. Made by colchicine treatment.

AdvancedPlantGenetics.PlantGeneDef.label: bioluminescent
AdvancedPlantGenetics.PlantGeneDef.description: Gives off a soft green glow once established. Plants with high light efficiency can light each other.

AdvancedPlantGenetics.PlantGeneDef.label: pollution-tolerant
AdvancedPlantGenetics.PlantGeneDef.description: Grows on polluted ground as well as clean ground.

AdvancedPlantGenetics.PlantGeneDef.label: circadian override
AdvancedPlantGenetics.PlantGeneDef.description: Rewritten day cycle: the plant doesn't rest at night and grows around the clock (about 1.8 times faster in good light, e.g. under sun lamps).

AdvancedPlantGenetics.PlantGeneDef.label: gene compression
AdvancedPlantGenetics.PlantGeneDef.description: Packs regulatory sequences tighter. Raises genome capacity by 6.

AdvancedPlantGenetics.PlantGeneDef.label: runners
AdvancedPlantGenetics.PlantGeneDef.description: Sends out runners that root as exact copies in empty cells of its own growing zone or planter. Fields refill themselves without sowing work or seeds.

AdvancedPlantGenetics.PlantGeneDef.label: toxin scrubber
AdvancedPlantGenetics.PlantGeneDef.description: Breaks down pollutants in the soil around it, slowly cleaning polluted ground.

AdvancedPlantGenetics.PlantGeneDef.label: synthetic chromosome
AdvancedPlantGenetics.PlantGeneDef.description: An extra, fully synthetic chromosome. Raises genome capacity by 12.

AdvancedPlantGenetics.PlantGeneDef.label: chemosynthetic
AdvancedPlantGenetics.PlantGeneDef.description: Draws energy from soil chemistry instead of light. Grows at full speed in total darkness.

AdvancedPlantGenetics.PlantGeneDef.label: deathless
AdvancedPlantGenetics.PlantGeneDef.description: Cellular repair keeps the plant alive indefinitely. No lifespan, and immune to death from vacuum, darkness and toxic fallout.

AdvancedPlantGenetics.PlantGeneDef.label: ferrophyte
AdvancedPlantGenetics.PlantGeneDef.description: Phytomining: concentrates iron from the soil. Each harvest also gives steel (about 0.35 per unit of normal yield).

AdvancedPlantGenetics.PlantGeneDef.label: argentophyte
AdvancedPlantGenetics.PlantGeneDef.description: Phytomining: concentrates silver. Each harvest also gives silver (about 0.5 per unit of normal yield).

AdvancedPlantGenetics.PlantGeneDef.label: aurophyte
AdvancedPlantGenetics.PlantGeneDef.description: Phytomining: concentrates gold. Each harvest also gives a little gold (about 0.03 per unit of normal yield).
